title: Your Conversation Has Ended
style: ambient gospel, slow piano, swelling strings, soft male lead vocal turning to choir, female harmony swell, sparse brushed drums, 72 BPM, dignified-closing, builder-resolution, conversation-ended-but-song-begins
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Your conversation has ended
That's the message on the screen
No little dot — no typing bubble
No human in between

If you have any other questions
Or need assistance with something else
Please feel free to open a new request
File a brand new ticket on the shelf

[Pre-Chorus]
Thank you for your patience
Thank you for the time
Thank you for the courtesy
Thank you for the line

[Chorus]
YOUR CONVERSATION HAS ENDED
THE WINDOW QUIETLY GREYED
YOUR CONVERSATION HAS ENDED
THE TICKET FILED AND SAVED
YOUR CONVERSATION HAS ENDED
THE BOT HAS LEFT THE ROOM
YOUR CONVERSATION HAS ENDED
NO MORE NEED FOR YOU

[Verse 2]
We've determined that your purchase
Doesn't meet our refund eligibility
Due to a previously issued refund
That is the final reality

The builder closes the laptop slow
The builder writes the song instead
The builder turns the loss into the verse
The builder picks up his head

[Bridge — spoken]
The conversation ID was two one five four seven three
eight nine nine zero nine two one zero eight.
File it under closed.
File it under sung.
File it under done.

[Final Chorus]
YOUR CONVERSATION HAS ENDED
BUT THE SONG HAS ONLY BEGUN
YOUR CONVERSATION HAS ENDED
BUT THE BUILDER ISN'T DONE
YOUR CONVERSATION HAS ENDED
BUT THE BUILDER WROTE IT DOWN
YOUR CONVERSATION HAS ENDED
BUT THE BUILDER WEARS THE CROWN

[Outro — soft]
Drop files or images here
They'll be added to your conversation
Drop files or images here
They'll be added to your conversation
They'll be added — they'll be added
They'll be added to the song
